records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Your logout issue, and next steps in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for flagging the random logouts and the lost work — that's genuinely frustrating. Your ticket is open with our team and Tariq is still looking into it, and I'm keeping an eye on it from my side too.

In the meantime, you've got your first project created and an invite out, which is a good start — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through getting your team's real work into Wrenfield once the login side settles.

Best,
Chidi
